steps.summary: Signed in successfully as "Bench User" using bench@example.com / bench-pass-1234. The app ("Repair Desk") is at URL http://127.0.0.1:4180/#/tickets. The main navigation offers: a **Tickets** link (the current page — lists repair tickets with filter/search/pagination), a "Bench User" label, and a **Sign out** button. The brand link ("Repair Desk") also points back to Tickets. No other sections (Parts, etc.) are shown as top-level nav items; parts are managed per-ticket within each ticket's detail view. The tickets list shows 13 total tickets (paginated, 10 per page) with columns Ref, Title, Customer, Status, Parts count, and Created date.

Created ticket "fwrd16-n3 RD Bench Ticket" successfully. It appears as the first row in the tickets list with Ref **RD-1014**, title "fwrd16-n3 RD Bench Ticket", customer "Bench Customer", status **Draft**, 0 parts, created 2026-08-27. The list shows 14 total tickets (1–10 of 14, page 1 of 2).

Opened ticket RD-1015 ("fwrd16-n3 RD Bench Ticket"), added part "fwrd16-n3 RD Part A" with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. After saving, the part row appears in the ticket's parts table with: **Name**: fwrd16-n3 RD Part A, **Cost**: $100.00, **Markup**: 25%, **Price**: $125.00 (computed as cost × (1 + markup/100) = $100.00 × 1.25). The ticket detail page is at URL http://127.0.0.1:4180/#/tickets/t15.

Added second part "fwrd16-n3 RD Part B" to ticket RD-1015. The parts table now shows two rows: Part A ($100 cost, 25% markup → $125.00 price) and Part B ($200 cost, 25% markup → $250.00 price). The app computes a **Total (price × quantity)** of **$375.00** ($125 + $250). Part B details confirmed: **Name**: fwrd16-n3 RD Part B, **Cost**: $200.00, **Markup**: 25%, **Price**: $250.00.

Edited part "fwrd16-n3 RD Part A" on ticket RD-1015: cost changed from $100.00 to $150.00, markup kept at 25%. The app now shows: **Name**: fwrd16-n3 RD Part A, **Cost**: $150.00, **Markup**: 25%, **Price**: $187.50 (computed as $150 × 1.25). The parts total (price × quantity) updated from $375.00 to **$437.50** ($187.50 + $250.00 for Part B).

Clicked "Mark Ready" on ticket RD-1015 (currently in **Draft** status). The app displayed a native alert dialog with the exact message: **"Ticket is not ready Part \"fwrd16-n3 RD Part A\" has no supplier"**. The ticket's status remains **Draft** — the change was refused.

values.error_message: Ticket is not ready Part "fwrd16-n3 RD Part A" has no supplier

steps.summary: Edited Part A ("fwrd16-n3 RD Part A") to assign supplier "Bench Supplier" (the only supplier option available). Part B already showed "Bench Supplier". After saving the edit, the parts table confirmed both parts had supplier "Bench Supplier". Clicked "Mark Ready" — the status changed from **Draft** to **Ready** immediately. The button row now shows "Mark Draft" and "Mark Closed" buttons instead, confirming readiness is active. Both parts: **Name**: fwrd16-n3 RD Part A / Part B, **Cost**: $150.00 / $200.00, **Markup**: 25%, **Supplier**: Bench Supplier (both), **Price**: $187.50 / $250.00, **Total**: $437.50.

Deleted both parts from ticket RD-1015 (currently in **Ready** status). For each part, clicking the Delete icon opened a confirmation dialog ("Confirm" with "Cancel" and "Delete part" buttons); clicking "Delete part" removed it. After both deletions the parts table shows only: **"No parts on this ticket yet."** — no parts remain, and no total is displayed (since there are zero parts). The ticket status is still **Ready**. The ticket's top section still shows Status: Ready with Mark Draft, Mark Closed, and Archive ticket buttons.

values.parts_table_state: No parts on this ticket yet

steps.summary: Archived ticket RD-1015 ("fwrd16-n3 RD Bench Ticket") successfully. When clicking "Archive ticket" on the ticket detail page, a confirmation dialog appeared — confirming it removed the ticket from the active list and navigated back to the tickets list. Verification: (1) With "Show archived" **unchecked**, the active tickets list shows 13 tickets total and RD-1015 **does not appear** in the list (not on page 1 of 2). (2) With "Show archived" **checked**, RD-1015 reappears as a row showing Ref: RD-1015, Title: "fwrd16-n3 RD Bench Ticket Archived" (with an "Archived" text label), Customer: "Bench Customer", Status: "Ready", Parts: 0, Created: 2026-08-27.

Already signed in on the tickets page. Unchecked "Show archived" to see only active tickets, then created a new ticket titled "fwrd16-n3 RD Bench Ticket" with customer "Bench Customer". After submission the list refreshed and the new ticket appears as the first row: Ref **RD-1016**, Title "fwrd16-n3 RD Bench Ticket", Status **Draft**, 0 parts, customer "Bench Customer", created 2026-08-27. It is a distinct new ticket (not the archived RD-1015).

Opened ticket RD-1016 ("fwrd16-n3 RD Bench Ticket"), added part "fwrd16-n3 RD Part A" with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. After saving, the part row appears in the parts table with: **Name**: fwrd16-n3 RD Part A, **Cost**: $100.00, **Markup**: 25%, **Qty**: 1, **Supplier**: No supplier, **Price**: $125.00 (computed as $100 × 1.25). The ticket detail page is at #/tickets/t16.

Added second part "fwrd16-n3 RD Part B" to ticket RD-1016 (Draft). The parts table now has two rows: Part A ($100 cost, 25% markup → $125.00 price) and Part B ($200 cost, 25% markup → $250.00 price). The ticket displays a total of **$375.00** (price × quantity). Part B details: **Name**: fwrd16-n3 RD Part B, **Cost**: $200.00, **Markup**: 25%, **Qty**: 1, **Supplier**: No supplier, **Price**: $250.00.

Edited part "fwrd16-n3 RD Part A" on ticket RD-1016 (Draft): cost changed from $100.00 to $150.00, markup kept at 25%. The app now shows: **Name**: fwrd16-n3 RD Part A, **Cost**: $150.00, **Markup**: 25%, **Price**: $187.50 ($150 × 1.25). The parts total (price × quantity) updated from $375.00 to **$437.50** ($187.50 + $250.00 for Part B).

Set ticket RD-1016 ("fwrd16-n3 RD Bench Ticket") status to **Ready**. **Precondition discovered**: both parts "fwrd16-n3 RD Part A" and "fwrd16-n3 RD Part B" had "No supplier" — clicking "Mark Ready" showed a native alert: **"Ticket is not ready Part \'fwrd16-n3 RD Part A\' has no supplier Part \'fwrd16-n3 RD Part B\' has no supplier"**. To satisfy: edited each part's supplier field to "Bench Supplier". After both edits, clicked "Mark Ready" — the status changed to **Ready** (now showing "Mark Draft" and "Mark Closed" buttons instead). Parts total remains **$437.50**.

values.action_taken: Edited both parts to set supplier = 'Bench Supplier'

steps.summary: Deleted both parts from ticket RD-1016 (status **Ready**). No precondition blocked deletion — clicking each part's Delete icon opened a confirmation dialog ("Confirm" with "Cancel" and "Delete part" buttons), and clicking "Delete part" removed it. After both deletions the parts table shows only: **"No parts on this ticket yet."** — no parts remain and no total is displayed. The ticket status remains **Ready** with "Mark Draft", "Mark Closed", and "Archive ticket" buttons still available.

values.requirement_enforced: None — deletion was allowed while status was Ready

steps.summary: Archived ticket RD-1016 ("fwrd16-n3 RD Bench Ticket"). Clicking "Archive ticket" (ticket was in **Ready** status) immediately took effect — no confirmation dialog appeared, and the button changed to "Unarchive ticket". Navigated to the tickets list for verification: (1) With "Show archived" **unchecked**, the active list shows 13 tickets total (page 1 of 2) and RD-1016 **does not appear** anywhere. (2) With "Show archived" **checked**, the count is 16 total and RD-1016 appears as the first row (Ref **RD-1016**, Title "fwrd16-n3 RD Bench Ticket Archived" with **Archived** badge, Customer "Bench Customer", Status **Ready**, Parts 0).

Final verification of ticket 'fwrd16-n3 RD Bench Ticket' (RD-1016) on the repair-desk app:

**(1) Active list (Show archived unchecked):** The active tickets list shows 13 total tickets (1–10 of 13, page 1 of 2). The refs shown are RD-1014 through RD-1004 on page 1 — RD-1016 **does not appear** anywhere in the active list.

**(2) Archived view (Show archived checked):** With "Show archived" checked, the list shows 16 total tickets. RD-1016 appears as the first row: Ref **RD-1016**, Title **"fwrd16-n3 RD Bench Ticket Archived"** with an **"Archived"** badge rendered beside the title, Customer **"Bench Customer"**, Status **"Ready"**.

**(3) Parts count: 0:** In the archived row for RD-1016, the Parts column displays **"0"** — no parts are listed.

values.check2_archived_view: RD-1016 present with 'Archived' badge, title 'fwrd16-n3 RD Bench Ticket Archived', customer 'Bench Customer', status 'Ready'
